script.code:
SELECT JSON_OBJECT(
       'now', DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), '+00:00', '+08:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'),
       'ia', (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(h.id AS CHAR), 'no', h.stock_movement_no, 'status', h.item_assembly_status, 'organization_id', h.organization_id,
                'plant_id', CAST(h.issuing_operation_faci AS CHAR), 'hold', h.material_hold_status, 'hold_at', h.material_hold_at, 'is_deleted', h.is_deleted,
                'ut', DATE_FORMAT(h.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f'))
                FROM sm_item_assembly h WHERE h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_HDguard.data.tenantId}}' AND h.id = {{node:code_node_HDguard.data.ia}}),
       'lines', (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(l.id AS CHAR), 'item_selection', l.item_selection, 'item_name', l.item_name,
                'quantity_uom', CAST(l.quantity_uom AS CHAR), 'total_quantity', CAST(l.total_quantity AS CHAR), 'required_qty', CAST(l.required_qty AS CHAR),
                'requested_qty', CAST(l.requested_qty AS CHAR), 'temp_qty_data', l.temp_qty_data, 'temp_hu_data', l.temp_hu_data, 'is_deleted', l.is_deleted))
                FROM sm_item_assembly_tlm8ve69_sub l WHERE l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_HDguard.data.tenantId}}' AND l.sm_item_assembly_id = {{node:code_node_HDguard.data.ia}} AND l.is_deleted = 0),
       'rows', (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(r.id AS CHAR), 'status', r.status, 'doc_line_id', r.doc_line_id, 'material_id', CAST(r.material_id AS CHAR),
                'bin_location', CAST(r.bin_location AS CHAR), 'batch_id', CAST(r.batch_id AS CHAR), 'from_category', r.from_category, 'open_qty', CAST(r.open_qty AS CHAR),
                'reserved_qty', CAST(r.reserved_qty AS CHAR), 'item_uom', CAST(r.item_uom AS CHAR), 'job_line_key', r.job_line_key))
                FROM on_reserved_gd r WHERE r.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_HDguard.data.tenantId}}' AND r.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_HDguard.data.org}}' AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.doc_type = 'Item Assembly'
                 AND r.doc_id = '{{node:code_node_HDguard.data.ia}}' AND r.status IN ('Allocated', 'Processing', 'Releasing')),
       'ticket_max', (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(p.step_name, 8) AS UNSIGNED)), 0) FROM gd_publish_step p
                WHERE p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_HDguard.data.tenantId}}' AND p.job_id = 'IAH|{{node:code_node_HDguard.data.ia}}' AND p.step_name LIKE 'TICKET|%' AND p.is_deleted = 0),
       'held', (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(p.id AS CHAR), 'n', CAST(SUBSTRING(p.step_name, 8) AS UNSIGNED),
                'started_at', DATE_FORMAT(p.started_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), 'op', p.result_ref))
                FROM gd_publish_step p WHERE p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_HDguard.data.tenantId}}' AND p.job_id = 'IAH|{{node:code_node_HDguard.data.ia}}' AND p.step_name LIKE 'TICKET|%' AND p.step_status = 'HELD'
                 AND p.is_deleted = 0),
       'transit', (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(q.id AS CHAR), 'no', q.stock_movement_no, 'status', q.stock_movement_status)
                FROM sm_location_transfer q WHERE q.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_HDguard.data.tenantId}}' AND q.is_deleted = 0 AND q.transfer_purpose = 'IA_SUPPLY' AND q.source_ia_id = '{{node:code_node_HDguard.data.ia}}'
                 AND q.stock_movement_status IN ('In Progress', 'Processing') ORDER BY q.id DESC LIMIT 1)) AS j

script.code:
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('kind', 'OUT', 'key', CONCAT(CAST(m.item_id AS CHAR), '|', CAST(m.bin_location_id AS CHAR), '|', COALESCE(CAST(m.batch_number_id AS CHAR), '')),
       'base', CAST(SUM(m.base_qty) AS CHAR)) AS j
  FROM inventory_movement m
  JOIN (SELECT GREATEST({{node:code_node_HDguard.data.ia}}, COALESCE(MAX(r.id), 0)) AS lo FROM inventory_movement r
         WHERE r.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_HDguard.data.tenantId}}' AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.id > {{node:code_node_HDguard.data.ia}} AND r.trx_no = CONVERT(UNHEX('{{node:code_node_HDplan.data.noHex}}') USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AND r.transaction_type = 'IA-R') b ON m.id > b.lo
 WHERE m.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_HDguard.data.tenantId}}' AND m.is_deleted = 0 AND m.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_HDguard.data.org}}' AND m.trx_no = CONVERT(UNHEX('{{node:code_node_HDplan.data.noHex}}') USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci
   AND m.transaction_type = 'IA' AND m.movement = 'OUT' AND m.inventory_category = 'Reserved'
 GROUP BY m.item_id, m.bin_location_id, m.batch_number_id
UNION ALL
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('kind', 'DELIVERED', 'id', CAST(d.id AS CHAR), 'material_id', CAST(d.material_id AS CHAR), 'bin_location', CAST(d.bin_location AS CHAR),
       'batch_id', CAST(d.batch_id AS CHAR), 'item_uom', CAST(d.item_uom AS CHAR), 'delivered_qty', CAST(d.delivered_qty AS CHAR)) AS j
  FROM on_reserved_gd d
  JOIN (SELECT GREATEST({{node:code_node_HDguard.data.ia}}, COALESCE(MAX(r.id), 0)) AS lo FROM inventory_movement r
         WHERE r.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_HDguard.data.tenantId}}' AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.id > {{node:code_node_HDguard.data.ia}} AND r.trx_no = CONVERT(UNHEX('{{node:code_node_HDplan.data.noHex}}') USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AND r.transaction_type = 'IA-R') b ON d.id > b.lo
 WHERE d.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_HDguard.data.tenantId}}' AND d.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_HDguard.data.org}}' AND d.is_deleted = 0 AND d.doc_type = 'Item Assembly' AND d.doc_id = '{{node:code_node_HDguard.data.ia}}' AND d.status = 'Delivered'
   AND d.doc_no = CONVERT(UNHEX('{{node:code_node_HDplan.data.noHex}}') USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci

script.code:
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('material_id', CAST(k.m AS CHAR), 'location_id', CAST(k.l AS CHAR), 'batch_id', CAST(NULLIF(k.b, 0) AS CHAR),
       'unrestricted_qty', CAST(COALESCE(IF(k.b = 0, ib.u, bb.u), 0) AS CHAR), 'block_qty', CAST(COALESCE(IF(k.b = 0, ib.bk, bb.bk), 0) AS CHAR),
       'item_rows', COALESCE(ib.n, 0), 'batch_rows', COALESCE(bb.n, 0), 'method', i.material_costing_method, 'fifo', COALESCE(f.n, 0), 'wa', COALESCE(w.n, 0)) AS j
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT jt.m, jt.l, jt.b FROM JSON_TABLE('{{node:code_node_HDdelta.data.keysJson}}', '$[*]' COLUMNS (m BIGINT PATH '$[0]', l BIGINT PATH '$[1]', b BIGINT PATH '$[2]')) jt) k
  JOIN item i ON i.id = k.m AND i.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_HDguard.data.tenantId}}' AND i.is_deleted = 0
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT x.material_id AS m, x.location_id AS l, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(x.unrestricted_qty) AS u, SUM(x.block_qty) AS bk
               FROM item_balance x
              WHERE x.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_HDguard.data.tenantId}}' AND x.is_deleted = 0 AND x.plant_id = {{node:code_node_HDdelta.data.plant}} AND x.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_HDguard.data.org}}' AND x.material_id IN ({{node:code_node_HDdelta.data.mats}})
              GROUP BY x.material_id, x.location_id) ib ON ib.m = k.m AND ib.l = k.l
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT y.material_id AS m, y.location_id AS l, y.batch_id AS b, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(y.unrestricted_qty) AS u, SUM(y.block_qty) AS bk
               FROM item_batch_balance y
              WHERE y.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_HDguard.data.tenantId}}' AND y.is_deleted = 0 AND y.plant_id = {{node:code_node_HDdelta.data.plant}} AND y.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_HDguard.data.org}}' AND y.material_id IN ({{node:code_node_HDdelta.data.mats}})
              GROUP BY y.material_id, y.location_id, y.batch_id) bb ON bb.m = k.m AND bb.l = k.l AND bb.b = k.b
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT fc.material_id AS m, COALESCE(fc.batch_id, 0) AS b, COUNT(*) AS n
               FROM fifo_costing_history fc
              WHERE fc.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_HDguard.data.tenantId}}' AND fc.is_deleted = 0 AND fc.plant_id = {{node:code_node_HDdelta.data.plant}} AND fc.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_HDguard.data.org}}' AND fc.material_id IN ({{node:code_node_HDdelta.data.mats}})
              GROUP BY fc.material_id, COALESCE(fc.batch_id, 0)) f ON f.m = k.m AND f.b = k.b
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT wc.material_id AS m, COALESCE(wc.batch_id, 0) AS b, COUNT(*) AS n
               FROM wa_costing_method wc
              WHERE wc.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_HDguard.data.tenantId}}' AND wc.is_deleted = 0 AND wc.plant_id = '{{node:code_node_HDdelta.data.plant}}' AND wc.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_HDguard.data.org}}' AND wc.material_id IN ({{node:code_node_HDdelta.data.mats}})
              GROUP BY wc.material_id, COALESCE(wc.batch_id, 0)) w ON w.m = k.m AND w.b = k.b
 ORDER BY k.m, k.l, k.b
